facts.text: Audrey takes her dogs to the park twice a week for practice.

evidence.quote: I take them to the park twice a week for practice - it's been a great bonding experience.

facts.text: Audrey and her dogs went on a trail hike that took two hours and offered stunning views.

evidence.quote: The hike took us two hours and it was stunning! We saw lots of amazing views and it was great to explore nature.

facts.text: Audrey and her dogs are described as growing together through their activities.

evidence.quote: They've come a long way. They have so much fun with it, it's a great physical and mental workout.
